result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations with three-digit characteristics (0/1 triples) of theta functions in three variables, together with linear forms in x, y, z, ξ, η, ζ (where ζ is read uncertainly) and parameters α, β, γ, apparently relating square roots of such forms to theta characteristics.
